_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your league. 'source' picks which one is used.

sleeper._comment: Either works. draft_id wins if both are set. You can paste a full Sleeper draft URL as draft_id.

espn._comment: league_id is the number in your ESPN league URL. Public leagues need no cookies.
_cookies: PRIVATE LEAGUES ONLY. To get these:
1. Open fantasy.espn.com in Chrome and log in.
2. F12 -> Application tab -> Storage -> Cookies -> https://fantasy.espn.com
3. Copy the 'espn_s2' value (long) and the 'SWID' value (in curly braces).
These expire every so often. If ESPN polling starts failing with 401, re-grab them.

demo._comment: Replays a finished draft so you can test without a live one. Defaults to a real completed 2025 ESPN league.
